description: Show a saved market map the account owns or co-authors: its sections, every company with its profile link, the PNG image_url, editor_url and public_url. Use it to reopen a map before editing it with edit_market_map, and to follow a map whose status is 'building' until it is 'done'. Free. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

map_id.description: The map id (from create_market_map, or the ?map= value of a Market Map Maker link).

name: get_market_map
title: Show a market map
